question: In which year was Bank of Madras established as the third Presidency Bank of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1843**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Bank of Madras** was established in the year **1843**, making it the third Presidency Bank in India after the **Bank of Calcutta** (1806) and the **Bank of Bombay** (1840).
 
• The establishment of the Bank of Madras was part of the British colonial efforts to introduce organized banking in India to facilitate trade and economic activities. *Hence, the year 1843 is correct.*
 
• The Presidency Banks were formed to cater to the financial needs of the British East India Company and to promote economic development in their respective regions.
